name: MAR Fund Small Grants Program: Traditional Small Grants Window
summary: Annual small grants for coastal and marine resource management in prioritised protected areas of the Mesoamerican Reef, covering sustainable ventures, resilience of protected areas and communities, waste and wastewater, and fish spawning sites.
reporting: Grantees submit the technical, financial, and environmental and social reports required by the grant agreement, on time.

deadline.text: October 20th, 2026. All proposals must be received no later than 11:59 p. m. in each country on that date.

status.quote: 19th REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS Open: August 25th - October 20th, 2026

opens.quote: 19th REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS Open: August 25th - October 20th, 2026

deadline.quote: The deadline for the submission of proposals is October 20th, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Community-based organizations, including women's and indigenous people's organizations, Non-governmental organizations, Governmental institutions, academic institutions, and individuals

geography.quote: Be duly registered or legally recognized in one of the four countries of the Mesoamerican Reef (MAR) region (Mexico, Belize, Guatemala, and Honduras)

access.quote: Complete proposals and the due diligence documentation, including the signed Appendix B, must be submitted through the on-line form/template on the MAR Fund webpage.

window.quote: MAR Fund is delighted to announce its Small Grants Program annual request for proposals (RfP) with two available financial windows

co_finance_required.quote: For this RfP, at least 25% of the total budget must come from other sources, as a match to the requested funds.

reporting.quote: submit all required technical, financial, and environmental and social reports on time, according to the grant agreement

amount.quote: proposals between 18 and 24 months may request a maximum amount of US$50,000
